name: HWR_SRVY_QSTN_HLPR_B
description:
This table will be used to store information associated with the multiple
choice questions being used in the Survey, both single selection and multiple selection.

columns.name: SUBSCRIBER_ID
columns.description: This is the Subscriber ID associated with the Survey. Used to differentiate between different survey projects.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_ID
columns.description: This is the Questionnaire ID associated with the Survey.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_VERSION
columns.description: This is the Questionnaire Version associated with the Questionnaire ID.

columns.name: QUESTION_ID
columns.description: This is the Question ID associated with the Questionnaire.

columns.name: QUESTION_VERSION
columns.description: This is the Question Version associated with the Question ID in the Questionnaire.

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: This is the Answer ID associated with the Question.

columns.name: QUESTION_TYPE
columns.description:
This determines the type of this question.
QUESTION_TYPE ::
0 --> Text Questions
1 --> Multiple Choice Questions – Single Selection
2 --> Multiple Choice Questions – Multiple Selection – 2 or more selections are possible
3 --> No Response

columns.name: QUESTIONS_HELPER_ATTR_1
columns.description: QUESTIONS_HELPER_ATTR_1. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: QUESTIONS_HELPER_ATTR_2
columns.description: QUESTIONS_HELPER_ATTR_2. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: QUESTIONS_HELPER_ATTR_3
columns.description: QUESTIONS_HELPER_ATTR_3. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: QUESTIONS_HELPER_ATTR_4
columns.description: QUESTIONS_HELPER_ATTR_4. This is the extra attribute in case if needed.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
